column2: The Record Layer: Every Segment in Exactly One Record, Nothing Defaulted, Unplaceable Segments Carried
The Transcript: One Line per Record, a Gap Marked as a Gap, No Stand-In Speaker
The Stage Runner: One Model Resident at a Time, the Token Never Escapes
The Stub Authority: stubtest Holds the whisperx Stubs to the Package They Describe
The whisperx Bindings: Every Library Call Bound as the Runner Expects, the Token Only to the Builder
The Orchestrator: One Process per Stage, Each Holding One Context on the Shared GPU Ledger
